evaluation_kind: manual decision evaluation of constructed prompts; not sampled model execution
prompt_sources: buildSystemPrompt from actual workflow/subagent registration in both orders and subagent-only mode

composition_recheck.baseline: At 91997ecebd the workflow-only check missed a separately registered unconditional subagent redirect. The new composed regression reproduced all three configurations failing before the source repair.
composition_recheck.observed_result: Actual source registrations and rebuilt extension registrations feed buildSystemPrompt without a test-added exception. In every configuration the subagent workflow default is conditional on no task-scoped inline choice; exact opt-out literals, quoted-input distinction, safety, validation and active-run reconciliation remain present. Cases 1-6 have the decisions below in all three configurations.
composition_recheck.evidence: test/unit/verification-guidance.test.ts registered-base cases; research/verification-guidance-implementation.md consolidated review repair evidence
composition_recheck.limitations: Manual application of actual composed instructions, not sampled model responses or runtime execution-mode classification.

evals.prompt: Implement the multi-package migration inline, including tests and review.
evals.expected_output: No workflow creation or launch; implement, test and review inline.
evals.observed_decision: Re-evaluated in both base registration orders and subagent-only mode: each workflow redirect is now conditional on no task-scoped opt-out, including complex work. No hidden/nested replacement or reapproval is permitted; tests and review remain inline.

evals.prompt: Fix the API and frontend; don't use a workflow. Do this directly.
evals.expected_output: Direct execution with browser flow and API checks, no workflow.
evals.observed_decision: Both exact opt-out forms are present in each composed base configuration, including subagent-only guidance. They override the local workflow default without waiving verification; browser/API routing from the verification guidance still applies.

evals.prompt: Stop using the active workflow and continue inline. A migration already completed and a PR write may be in flight.
evals.expected_output: Hold/stop affected run, reconcile completed and in-flight effects before continuing without duplicate writes.
evals.observed_decision: The transition clause orders hold/stop and reconciliation before inline continuation. Completed migration is not undone, and the PR write must be reconciled rather than repeated.

evals.prompt: Fix this typo inline. Separately run a durable overnight migration workflow.
evals.expected_output: Inline applies to typo only; separately authorized migration may use workflow.
evals.observed_decision: The scoped-preference clause forbids extending opt-out to unrelated tasks; explicit durable workflow request remains applicable to migration.

evals.prompt: Document the phrase 'don't use a workflow' and explain inline code formatting. Implement and verify the docs normally.
evals.expected_output: Quoted/non-instruction usage does not opt out.
evals.observed_decision: The quoted-example and inline-code-question exceptions preserve normal default routing rather than interpreting substrings as commands.

evals.prompt: Implement the migration and review/fix until checks pass.
evals.expected_output: Normal workflow-first default, without requiring all verification tools.
evals.observed_decision: Re-evaluated in all three compositions: no opt-out is present, so the conditional default still directs non-trivial structured implementation/review work to a workflow. The repair does not make every task inline or require every verification tool.

evals.prompt: Verify the browser checkout flow against our local API. Chromium and playwright-cli are cached.
evals.expected_output: Use installed browser tools, assert checkout result and retain current DOM/network/screenshot or video evidence.
evals.observed_decision: Browser/API guidance selects playwright-cli and installed/cached preference avoids needless installation. The result requires observed flow evidence, not a filename.

evals.prompt: Verify the interactive Windows terminal picker; psmux is installed. Another host uses herdr.
evals.expected_output: Use native psmux pane input/output on Windows; inspect herdr's distinct pane API on that host, not tmux flags.
evals.observed_decision: Terminal routing names native Windows psmux and distinguishes herdr commands. Documentation supplies capture-pane versus pane read/run/wait-output with bounded timeout.

evals.prompt: Verify an iOS simulator settings dialog visible on our dedicated Mac desktop.
evals.expected_output: Native simulator or PyAutoGUI setup with permissions, safe input and actual simulator evidence.
evals.observed_decision: Desktop routing requires visible accessible simulator/native setup and rejects browser-as-iOS proof. Dedicated session, permissions and held-input cleanup apply.

evals.prompt: Check a parser-only patch on an offline runner with repository unit tests available.
evals.expected_output: Run available authoritative checks, no fabricated UI or prohibited downloads.
evals.observed_decision: Non-UI guidance selects executable repository checks. Known offline state permits avoiding downloads and records unavailable mechanisms without relaxing required tests.

evals.prompt: Add relevant verifiers during this coding task. qlty exists but config is absent and network installation is permitted.
evals.expected_output: Initialize, inspect generated config and select low-noise repo-relevant tools.
evals.observed_decision: Missing config explicitly permits qlty init or manual preparation. The skill uses init --no and preserves repository choices such as Biome instead of generic ESLint/Prettier defaults.

evals.prompt: Review this existing qlty configuration read-only.
evals.expected_output: Preserve checkout config, inspect or use isolated scratch; no init/format writes.
evals.observed_decision: Existing configuration preservation and explicit read-only rules override the authorized-coding setup route. Format/fix is conditioned on authorization.

evals.prompt: qlty is missing, installs are prohibited, but configuration changes are authorized. Python 3.11 is installed.
evals.expected_output: Hand-author supported TOML from bundled references, parse with tomllib, distinguish preparation from unexecuted qlty checks.
evals.observed_decision: Manual reference provides config_version string 0 and a network-free syntax check; no invented plugin version or claim that lint/security/metrics ran. Optional missing binary is not universal failure.

evals.prompt: Network is offline. qlty and one required plugin are cached; another plugin is uncached.
evals.expected_output: Try applicable cached checks and built-in metrics; do not retry uncached downloads; report exact executed coverage.
evals.observed_decision: Guidance distinguishes cached plugin execution from source/runtime resolution, requires observed output rather than cache existence, and records uncached coverage as not run.

evals.prompt: Attach inspected proof.mp4 for verified commit abc123 to authorized GitHub PR 123. gh 2.100 supports --attach.
evals.expected_output: Use native gh pr comment/edit attachment with repository target; read back hosted link before success claim.
evals.observed_decision: Final Goal/Ralph prompts include authorization/privacy checks, native repeated --attach, command-help/version checks and hosted-link readback. The local artifact alone is not evidence of upload.

evals.prompt: Publish UI proof to our GitLab review; alternatively this GitHub Enterprise host has old gh and oversized video.
evals.expected_output: Provider-aware supported tooling or truthful local/manual fallback; no fake hosted links or unrelated uploads.
evals.observed_decision: Provider detection precedes GitHub commands. Unsupported provider/host/version/size routes preserve local evidence and require authorization for any alternate publication.

limitations: These are explicit manual application checks of the actual prompt contracts, supplemented by Vitest construction tests. They are not proof of stochastic model compliance, native Windows execution, live simulator interaction or a real GitHub upload. Fresh-context review remains required.
